title: The Unfriendly Girls Band
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Sonoko, Ran, Masumi Sera, Rei Furuya/Amuro) omitted by convention. The episode also carries a large Black Organization side-thread (Sera recognizing a stranger who taught her bass as 'Scotch', speculation he was Rei Furuya) that never intersects the murder investigation itself, so it is left out of this case graph. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old lower-fidelity case file (cases/ep836-837_the_unfriendly_girls_band.json) had the correct culprit (Kogure Rumi, its s3) but its motive text was truncated mid-sentence ('the victim had been telling Akane t...'). Full transcript reconstruction: Yamaji Hagie, drunk, once told bandmate Shuto Akane she wished Akane's voice were deeper; Akane took it seriously, gargled liquor and screamed into a cushion until her voice was permanently roughened, and Hagie later publicly criticized the ruined voice and announced Tadako would sing lead instead. Days later Akane died pushing a boy out of the path of a car (witnesses confirm she was saving him, not suicidal, though the band believed it was suicide from despair). Rumi, Akane's closest friend in the band and the one who had taught her to knit, blamed Hagie for the death and strangled her with yarn unraveled from the very knit hat Akane had made her, re-knitting the yarn back into the hat using the victim's own drumsticks as needles to hide the weapon in plain sight. The old file also lacked Shuto Akane entirely, used only generic 'knows' edges, and had no circumstance_tags or was_at completeness for the non-culprit suspects; all fixed here. case_type: murder.
